Glycogen branching defect; liver dysfunction 80-99%, myopathy and dilated cardiomyopathy 30-79%. Neuronal morphology alone does not establish functional damage.
Primary carcinoma of the abdominal peritoneal lining; ovarian-type histology does not change its peritoneal origin.
Neoplasm originates in the lung apex. Brachial plexus and chest wall invasion can occur, but qualifying frequencies are not established for this umbrella.
Definition specifies cervical origin from mesonephric remnants. Cervix is outside the axes; the renal ancestry does not establish kidney involvement.
Human hepadnaviral disease is hepatitis B infection, with hepatic tropism; both infectious mechanism and liver location apply.
B-lymphoblastic leukemia is a blood and marrow malignancy. Lymphoid lineage alone does not make leukemia a lymphoma or an immune-mediated disease.

Bacterial infection directly inflames the dermis and subcutaneous tissue; deeper or orbital involvement is subtype-specific.
Supernumerary teeth are a dental developmental disorder; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
